Verifies label data, published dosages, pricing and refund terms against primary sources before publication and dates every page.","url":"https\://vappocept.com/about/"},{"@type":"WebPage","@id":"https\://vappocept.com/#webpage","url":"https\://vappocept.com/","name":"VapoCept Official Website Reference — Ingredients, Doses, Discount & Refund","isPartOf":{"@id":"https\://vappocept.com/#website"},"about":{"@id":"https\://vappocept.com/#product"},"reviewedBy":{"@id":"https\://vappocept.com/#reviewer"},"editor":{"@id":"https\://vappocept.com/#editor"},"datePublished":"2026-08-24","dateModified":"2026-08-26","inLanguage":"en-US","primaryImageOfPage":{"@type":"ImageObject","url":"https\://vappocept.com/assets/img/vapocept-3-bottle.png"}},{"@type":"Product","@id":"https\://vappocept.com/#product","name":"VapoCept","image":["https\://vappocept.com/assets/img/vapocept-3-bottle.png","https\://vappocept.com/assets/img/vapocept-6-bottle.png"],"description":"Cognitive function and memory support supplement sold as a Clinical Memory Restoration Clinical Memory Restoration formula. 30 capsules per bottle, one daily. Ingredient lists differ between the seller's own websites and no doses are published.","category":"Dietary Supplement","brand":{"@type":"Brand","name":"VapoCept"},"additionalProperty":[{"@type":"PropertyValue","name":"Serving size","value":"1 capsule"},{"@type":"PropertyValue","name":"Capsules per container","value":"30"},{"@type":"PropertyValue","name":"Servings per container","value":"30"},{"@type":"PropertyValue","name":"Individual doses disclosed","value":"No"},{"@type":"PropertyValue","name":"Supplement Facts panel published","value":"No"}],"offers":{"@type":"AggregateOffer","priceCurrency":"USD","lowPrice":"69","highPrice":"294","offerCount":"3","availability":"https\://schema.org/InStock","url":"https\://vappocept.com/#pricing","offers":[{"@type":"Offer","name":"Starter — 1 to 2 bottles","price":"69.00","priceCurrency":"USD","availability":"https\://schema.org/InStock","url":"https\://vappocept.com/#pricing"},{"@type":"Offer","name":"3 bottles — 90-day supply","price":"147.00","priceCurrency":"USD","availability":"https\://schema.org/InStock","url":"https\://vappocept.com/#pricing"},{"@type":"Offer","name":"6 bottles — 180-day supply","price":"234.00","priceCurrency":"USD","availability":"https\://schema.org/InStock","url":"https\://vappocept.com/#pricing"}]}},{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is VapoCept?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"VapoCept is a cognitive-support supplement sold under the tagline &ldquo;Clinical Memory Restoration&rdquo;, and the honest answer is that which product you receive depends on which website you order from. The bottle artwork shows a capsule product, 30 capsules per bottle, one daily. One official-looking site sells a powder you stir into water. Another sells a prebiotic and probiotic capsule with an entirely different ingredient list. It is a dietary supplement, not a medicine, and it is not FDA-approved. See the three-site comparison."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What are the VapoCept ingredients?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"That depends on the page. One site lists Green Tea Extract, Apple Cider Vinegar, a &ldquo;Fiber Blend&rdquo; and a &ldquo;Vitamin B Complex&rdquo;. Another lists Chicory Root Inulin, Potato Resistant Starch and a three-strain probiotic blend. Those are different products &mdash; a thermogenic-and-fibre formula versus a gut-microbiome formula. Neither publishes a single milligram figure, and two of the four entries on the first list are ingredient categories rather than ingredients. Full detail on the ingredients page."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Are the VapoCept doses disclosed?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No. Not on any page we could find. No Supplement Facts panel is displayed, no blend total is given, and no individual amounts appear. That matters because the fibre ingredients on one of the lists &mdash; inulin and resistant starch &mdash; are studied at 5&ndash;30 grams daily, amounts no capsule can hold, and green tea catechin trials used 250&ndash;500 mg. Without numbers, none of that can be checked."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How long is the VapoCept money-back guarantee?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Either 180 days or 60 days, depending which page you read. One site states 180 days, four times over. Another states an &ldquo;unconditional 60-day guarantee&rdquo; and then, in the same paragraph, requires &ldquo;at least 30 days of use&rdquo; before a claim &mdash; which makes the practical window roughly days 30 to 60. A paid advertorial about the product refers to 30-day return requirements. Screenshot the terms on your page. See the refund clock."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How much does VapoCept cost and is there a discount?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The pages disagree here too. Both pages list 2 bottles at $79 each, 3 at $69 each and 6 at $49 each. The other lists two bottles at $158 ($79 each), three at $207 ($69 each) and six at $294 ($49 each) &mdash; a $10 to $20 per-bottle difference for the same quantity. Savings on both are measured against reference prices ($179 and $99 a bottle) that appear only as crossed-out numbers. Current pricing is on the VapoCept official website."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is VapoCept FDA approved?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No, and no dietary supplement is. The FDA does not approve supplements the way it approves prescription drugs &mdash; there is no pre-market approval and no requirement to demonstrate efficacy before sale. Facilities are registered and subject to inspection, which is a different thing. One of these pages displays an &ldquo;FDA&rdquo; badge, which is misleading on any supplement."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is VapoCept a capsule or a powder?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Both, according to its own marketing, which is the clearest illustration of the problem. The bottle artwork and one site describe capsules, 30 per bottle, one daily. Another site says explicitly &ldquo;one scoop a day &mdash; no pills, no fuss&rdquo; and instructs you to stir it into cold water. A product cannot be both, so at least one of those pages is describing something other than what it ships."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does VapoCept work for weight loss?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No trial has been published on any of these finished products, so the only honest assessment is ingredient by ingredient &mdash; and without doses even that is limited. Green tea extract has real but modest evidence at 250&ndash;500 mg of catechins. Inulin and resistant starch have real satiety evidence at gram-scale amounts a capsule cannot deliver. Expect little, and treat any improvement as most likely coming from the diet and activity changes that accompany starting something new."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How long does VapoCept take to work?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"One page suggests several weeks, another gives no timeline. Judged by the ingredients, green tea and fibre trials ran 8&ndash;12 weeks, so 90 days would be a fair assessment window &mdash; which on the 60-day guarantee sits a month past your refund deadline. If you try it, weigh weekly at the same time and compare fortnightly averages, and decide by day 50."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Who actually makes VapoCept?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No manufacturer is named on either page. Checkout routes to third-party order platforms and, in one case, the page&rsquo;s own canonical URL points to a completely different store domain. One page carries Portuguese-language image filenames and an expert endorsement from a person whose credentials are not verifiable. There is no company standing behind the formula in the way there would be behind an established brand."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Where can you buy VapoCept?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Through the VapoCept official website &mdash; but note that several sites claim that status and they sell different products. No authorised retail listing has been identified. Whichever page you use, buying elsewhere puts your purchase outside that seller&rsquo;s order records, which is what any guarantee is administered against."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is VapoCept a scam?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"There is no evidence that orders go unfulfilled, and the ingredients named are real compounds with genuine research behind some of them. Our criticism is narrower and more specific: three sites claim to be official and describe three different products; no page publishes a single dose; the guarantee is 180 days in one place and 60 with a 30-day condition in another; the prices differ by up to $20 a bottle; savings are anchored on prices nobody has paid; one page runs a countdown timer that resets on reload; and no manufacturer is named anywhere. Our full review weighs whether that adds up to a purchase worth making."}}]},{"@type":"BreadcrumbList","itemListElement":[{"@type":"ListItem","position":1,"name":"Home","item":"https\://vappocept.com/"}]}]}\</script>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

The bar measures how much published human research                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|       supports that ingredient \<em>for weight or appetite specifically\</em>, before the dose question                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|       is applied.\</p>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|     \</div>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|     \<ul class="vc-doss">\<li class="is-strong vc-reveal" data-w="54">\<div class="vc-doss\_\_top">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_name">Green Tea Extract (EGCG)\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_chip vc-doss\_\_chip--core">Real, modest, dose-dependent\</span>\</div>\<div class="vc-doss\_\_bar">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_track">\<i>\</i>\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_pct">54/100\</span>\</div>\<p>The most studied ingredient that appears on any VapoCept page. Catechins, principally EGCG, raise energy expenditure slightly and meta-analyses report small average weight differences &mdash; typically a kilogram or two over months, often not sustained. Trials generally used \<strong>250–500 mg of catechins daily\</strong>, frequently alongside caffeine, which is where much of the thermogenic effect comes from. Worth knowing that high-dose concentrated green tea extract carries a documented, rare liver-injury signal &mdash; EFSA has reviewed it and several national regulators have issued cautions.\</p>\</li>\<li class=" vc-reveal" data-w="50">\<div class="vc-doss\_\_top">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_name">Chicory Root Inulin\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_chip vc-doss\_\_chip--core">Genuine prebiotic fibre\</span>\</div>\<div class="vc-doss\_\_bar">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_track">\<i>\</i>\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_pct">50/100\</span>\</div>\<p>A real, well-characterised prebiotic that ferments in the colon and feeds \<em>Bifidobacteria\</em>. Evidence for satiety and for modest metabolic markers exists, and European authorities have accepted a bowel-function claim for it. But the studied amounts are \<strong>5–15 grams daily\</strong> &mdash; that is grams, in a sachet or a tablespoon, not something a single capsule can hold. Expect gas and bloating in the first fortnight; that is the fibre working, and it is dose-related.\</p>\</li>\<li class=" vc-reveal" data-w="34">\<div class="vc-doss\_\_top">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_name">Apple Cider Vinegar\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_chip">Small trials, large marketing\</span>\</div>\<div class="vc-doss\_\_bar">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_track">\<i>\</i>\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_pct">34/100\</span>\</div>\<p>Acetic acid has a plausible mechanism &mdash; it slows gastric emptying and blunts the post-meal glucose rise &mdash; and a handful of small trials report modest weight differences. The studies used roughly \<strong>15–30 ml of liquid vinegar\</strong> daily, equivalent to well over a gram of acetic acid. Dried ACV powder in a capsule delivers a fraction of that, and the acetic acid content of a powder is rarely stated at all.\</p>\</li>\<li class=" vc-reveal" data-w="42">\<div class="vc-doss\_\_top">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_name">Potato Resistant Starch\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_chip">Real fibre, gram-scale\</span>\</div>\<div class="vc-doss\_\_bar">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_track">\<i>\</i>\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_pct">42/100\</span>\</div>\<p>Resistant starch reaches the colon undigested and ferments into short-chain fatty acids, with reasonable evidence for insulin sensitivity and satiety. Same problem as inulin: the trials use \<strong>15–30 grams daily\</strong>. There is no capsule format in which this ingredient can be delivered at a researched amount, and any product listing it in a capsule is listing it for the label rather than the effect.\</p>\</li>\<li class="is-weak vc-reveal" data-w="22">\<div class="vc-doss\_\_top">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_name">&ldquo;Probiotic Blend&rdquo; (3 strains, unnamed)\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_chip vc-doss\_\_chip--weak">Strain-specific or nothing\</span>\</div>\<div class="vc-doss\_\_bar">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_track">\<i>\</i>\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_pct">22/100\</span>\</div>\<p>Probiotic evidence is \<strong>strain-specific\</strong>, not species-specific and certainly not category-specific &mdash; a finding for one documented strain says nothing about another. A blend described only as &ldquo;three strains&rdquo; with no strain designations and no CFU count cannot be evaluated at all. \<em>Akkermansia muciniphila\</em> is named in passing on one page; it is a genuinely interesting organism in metabolic research, and it is also difficult to keep viable, which is presumably why that page tells you to refrigerate the bottle.\</p>\</li>\<li class="is-weak vc-reveal" data-w="10">\<div class="vc-doss\_\_top">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_name">&ldquo;Fiber Blend&rdquo; / &ldquo;Vitamin B Complex&rdquo;\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_chip vc-doss\_\_chip--weak">Not ingredients, categories\</span>\</div>\<div class="vc-doss\_\_bar">\<span class="vc-doss\_\_track">\<i>\</i>\</span>\<span class="vc-doss\_\_pct">10/100\</span>\</div>\<p>These are the two entries on the powder page that are not ingredients at all. A &ldquo;fiber blend&rdquo; could be inulin, psyllium, acacia, cellulose or maltodextrin &mdash; compounds with entirely different effects. A &ldquo;vitamin B complex&rdquo; could be any subset of eight vitamins at any amount. Naming a category instead of a compound is the least informative thing a label can do while still appearing to disclose something.\</p>\</li>\</ul>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|     \<div class="vc-note mt-4">                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|     \</div> |     \<div class="mx-auto" style="max-width:860px">\<div class="accordion vc-acc" id="homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH0">\<button class="accordion-button" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC0" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="homeC0">What is VapoCept?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC0" class="accordion-collapse collapse show" aria-labelledby="homeH0" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>\<strong>VapoCept is a cognitive-support supplement sold under the tagline &ldquo;Clinical Memory Restoration&rdquo;, and the honest answer is that which product you receive depends on which website you order from.\</strong> The bottle artwork shows a capsule product, 30 capsules per bottle, one daily. One official-looking site sells a powder you stir into water. Another sells a prebiotic and probiotic capsule with an entirely different ingredient list. It is a dietary supplement, not a medicine, and it is not FDA-approved. See \<a href='[/#which-vapocept](https://vappocept.com/#which-vapocept)'>the three-site comparison\</a>.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH1">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC1">What are the VapoCept ingredients?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC1" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH1" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>That depends on the page. One site lists Green Tea Extract, Apple Cider Vinegar, a &ldquo;Fiber Blend&rdquo; and a &ldquo;Vitamin B Complex&rdquo;. Another lists Chicory Root Inulin, Potato Resistant Starch and a three-strain probiotic blend. Those are different products &mdash; a thermogenic-and-fibre formula versus a gut-microbiome formula. \<strong>Neither publishes a single milligram figure\</strong>, and two of the four entries on the first list are ingredient categories rather than ingredients. Full detail on the \<a href='[/vapocept-ingredients/](https://vappocept.com/vapocept-ingredients/)'>ingredients page\</a>.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH2">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC2" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC2">Are the VapoCept doses disclosed?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC2" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH2" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>\<strong>No. Not on any page we could find.\</strong> No Supplement Facts panel is displayed, no blend total is given, and no individual amounts appear. That matters because the fibre ingredients on one of the lists &mdash; inulin and resistant starch &mdash; are studied at \<strong>5&ndash;30 grams daily\</strong>, amounts no capsule can hold, and green tea catechin trials used 250&ndash;500 mg. Without numbers, none of that can be checked.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH3">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC3" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC3">How long is the VapoCept money-back guarantee?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC3" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH3" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>\<strong>Either 180 days or 60 days, depending which page you read.\</strong> One site states 180 days, four times over. Another states an &ldquo;unconditional 60-day guarantee&rdquo; and then, in the same paragraph, requires &ldquo;at least 30 days of use&rdquo; before a claim &mdash; which makes the practical window roughly days 30 to 60. A paid advertorial about the product refers to 30-day return requirements. Screenshot the terms on your page. See \<a href='[/#refund-clock](https://vappocept.com/#refund-clock)'>the refund clock\</a>.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH4">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC4" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC4">How much does VapoCept cost and is there a discount?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC4" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH4" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>The pages disagree here too. Both pages list 2 bottles at $79 each, 3 at $69 each and 6 at $49 each. The other lists two bottles at $158 ($79 each), three at $207 ($69 each) and six at $294 ($49 each) &mdash; a $10 to $20 per-bottle difference for the same quantity. Savings on both are measured against reference prices ($179 and $99 a bottle) that appear only as crossed-out numbers. Current pricing is on the \<a href='[/order/](https://vappocept.com/order/)' rel='nofollow sponsored'>VapoCept official website\</a>.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH5">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC5" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC5">Is VapoCept FDA approved?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC5" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH5" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>\<strong>No, and no dietary supplement is.\</strong> The FDA does not approve supplements the way it approves prescription drugs &mdash; there is no pre-market approval and no requirement to demonstrate efficacy before sale. Facilities are \<em>registered\</em> and subject to inspection, which is a different thing. One of these pages displays an &ldquo;FDA&rdquo; badge, which is misleading on any supplement.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH6">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC6" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC6">Is VapoCept a capsule or a powder?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC6" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH6" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>Both, according to its own marketing, which is the clearest illustration of the problem. The bottle artwork and one site describe capsules, 30 per bottle, one daily. Another site says explicitly &ldquo;one scoop a day &mdash; no pills, no fuss&rdquo; and instructs you to stir it into cold water. A product cannot be both, so at least one of those pages is describing something other than what it ships.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH7">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC7" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC7">Does VapoCept work for weight loss?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC7" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH7" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>No trial has been published on any of these finished products, so the only honest assessment is ingredient by ingredient &mdash; and without doses even that is limited. Green tea extract has real but modest evidence at 250&ndash;500 mg of catechins. Inulin and resistant starch have real satiety evidence at gram-scale amounts a capsule cannot deliver. Expect little, and treat any improvement as most likely coming from the diet and activity changes that accompany starting something new.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH8">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC8" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC8">How long does VapoCept take to work?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC8" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH8" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>One page suggests several weeks, another gives no timeline. Judged by the ingredients, green tea and fibre trials ran 8&ndash;12 weeks, so 90 days would be a fair assessment window &mdash; which on the 60-day guarantee sits a month past your refund deadline. If you try it, weigh weekly at the same time and compare fortnightly averages, and decide by day 50.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH9">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC9" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC9">Who actually makes VapoCept?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC9" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH9" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>No manufacturer is named on either page. Checkout routes to third-party order platforms and, in one case, the page&rsquo;s own canonical URL points to a completely different store domain. One page carries Portuguese-language image filenames and an expert endorsement from a person whose credentials are not verifiable. There is no company standing behind the formula in the way there would be behind an established brand.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH10">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC10" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC10">Where can you buy VapoCept?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC10" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH10" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>Through the \<a href='[/order/](https://vappocept.com/order/)' rel='nofollow sponsored'>VapoCept official website\</a> &mdash; but note that several sites claim that status and they sell different products. No authorised retail listing has been identified. Whichever page you use, buying elsewhere puts your purchase outside that seller&rsquo;s order records, which is what any guarantee is administered against.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\<div class="accordion-item">\<h3 class="accordion-header" id="homeH11">\<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#homeC11" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="homeC11">Is VapoCept a scam?\</button>\</h3>\<div id="homeC11" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="homeH11" data-bs-parent="#homeAcc">\<div class="accordion-body">\<p>There is no evidence that orders go unfulfilled, and the ingredients named are real compounds with genuine research behind some of them. Our criticism is narrower and more specific: \<strong>three sites claim to be official and describe three different products\</strong>; no page publishes a single dose; the guarantee is 180 days in one place and 60 with a 30-day condition in another; the prices differ by up to $20 a bottle; savings are anchored on prices nobody has paid; one page runs a countdown timer that resets on reload; and no manufacturer is named anywhere. Our \<a href='[/vapocept-review/](https://vappocept.com/vapocept-review/)'>full review\</a> weighs whether that adds up to a purchase worth making.\</p>\</div>\</div>\</div>\</div>\</div> |

| \<section class="vc-sec" id="who-checks">
